points.description: Names hydrolysis as a key stage.
Names acidogenesis (acid formation / fermentation) as a key stage.
Names acetogenesis (acetic acid / acetate formation) as a key stage.
Names methanogenesis (methane formation) as a key stage.

rubric.notes: Each of the four stages (hydrolysis, acidogenesis, acetogenesis, methanogenesis) is worth 0.5 marks; clear synonyms such as 'acid formation' or 'methane formation' are accepted. Total is rounded to a whole number (marks are 0, 1 or 2): all four = 2, two or three correct = 1, one or none = 0. A wrong stage earns nothing but does not cancel other correct ones.
